The lower right hand is in the abhaya mudra, a gesture that signifies reassurance and the removal of fear. The lower left hand points to the raised left leg, which symbolizes liberation. Nataraja is often depicted with a halo of flames, which represents the manifest universe. He is shown standing on a lotus pedestal, which represents the growth of spirituality. Sometimes, Nataraja is shown lifting his left leg (or in rare cases, the right leg) and balancing/trampling upon a demon shown as a dwarf (Apasmara). This demon represents ignorance, and the act of balancing/trampling upon it symbolizes the triumph of knowledge over ignorance."
